text: Accept your Shadow as an undiscovered part of the Divine. Do not fight your "dark" sides, but explore them with compassion. In your envy there may hide a thirst for the fullness of being, in your anger - a distorted striving for justice. You know very little about yourself. By integrating your Shadow, you do not become worse, you become more whole, returning the exiled parts of your soul back into the light of divine acceptance and love, giving them the opportunity for healing.
